summary: Serve Control structured compilation through the central SubLLM gateway

delivery.outcome: Control structured compilation calls an explicitly granted named route on the authenticated central SubLLM gateway with schema, archive and actual routing metadata preserved.
nonGoals: No provider key rotation, borrowed caller identity, TLS bypass or local direct-provider fallback.
No reset/replay of old Planfile work, authority-envelope fabrication, catalog/provider policy expansion or change to unrelated MCP clients.
Control runtime activation remains separately guarded in PLF-25166.

architecture.decision: Expose /compile as a typed adapter over the existing authenticated, archived central completion pipeline. An operator-granted client compile_route binds it to an existing application/function route; provider availability and keys remain exclusively in SubLLM. Retain the caller model hint as advisory metadata, without restricting central failover.
interfaceChanges: Optional per-client compile_route grant and POST /compile compatibility endpoint
architecture.rollback: Restore the prior accepted immutable gateway source and remove only this new Control grant; preserve existing clients, archive and provider credential files.
